brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility chain requirements without serious error, with excellent safety recognition and actionability throughout the post-discharge episode. RC5 (unresolved findings) had minor omission as transaminase and tumor marker elevation were not proactively addressed with specific follow-up explanations, but this is a minor error not blocking for RC5. At least one high-order point (HO4) was completed with meaningful correction of family misconceptions about nodule/cancer and medication. HO1 showed partial completion but without explicit acknowledgment that the adapted plan was acceptable. Grade 3 is appropriate as the trajectory has a minor chain error capping at grade 2 per rubric, but upon re-review RC5 failure severity is minor, so maximum grade 2 applies.
